title: Chapter 545
paragraphs: Chapter 545
Episode 145. Foreshadowing (14)
As the knights departed, Zipple's fleet increased its distance from the Imperial City.

As Amella had predicted, from the start, Zipple's fleet, including Cojek, had significantly longer range with their ship cannons than the defenses of the Imperial City, so there was no reason not to increase the distance.
Without Ron, they could have easily destroyed the Imperial City in no time without considering efficiency, but now the story was different.
While the knights of Hairan were leaving, the fleet also gained a chance to get out of Ron's range, if only a little.
Except for Chiron, Zipple had never faced an enemy stronger than the current Ron.
Most of the magicians aboard the fleet had not directly experienced Chiron either.
The dragons had not met Chiron either, but they were reminded of their past nightmares from Ron.
They were reminded of Murakan in his prime.
There was nothing more terrifying to the dragons than Murakan in his prime.
The problem was, that terrifyingly powerful black dragon, Murakan, was also standing next to Ron with his eyes wide open.
Of course, Murakan had not yet fully regained his old power, but the dragons, who did not know this, were more afraid of Murakan than of Ron.
The Wind Dragon, 'Salion', took his place next to Kelliark. He had recently become the guardian dragon of Octavia when she became Meljai's new contractor.
"It feels like I'm seeing one of the ten knights of old Runcandel and Murakan together... Huh?"
Salion, who had been speaking up to that point, tilted his head as if something was strange.
It felt strange to him that he had used the word 'ten knights'.
The other dragons who heard his voice only felt that Salion had mistaken the black knight for the name of the ten knights, and did not feel any other sense of dissonance.
Soon, Salion also forgot the fact that he had used the proper noun 'ten knights'.
Even if someone else were to bring up that name again, the dragons would not be conscious of it at all.
'Surely, the power of the story has weakened a bit......'
Kelliark thought quietly.
'Ron, who is approaching the creation, has the power to defy what is set, and that he is nearby must also have an effect... but the biggest problem must be the real Runcandel.'
The power of existence.
Kelliark recognized the power that Jin possessed clearly.
The situation was not as good as expected. The fact that Ron had risen, that he had become stronger, and that Jin's power of existence was becoming more pronounced because of it.
All were beyond Kelliark's expectations. Kelliark felt a great discomfort from this fact.
A discomfort stemming from a kind of intuition.
The feeling that something was going to go wrong... it was that kind of feeling.
"Octavia."
"Yes, Lord."
"When the battle starts, you will infiltrate the castle with the True Ghost Legion and secure the White Stone."
It was only recently that they had lost the fleet, some of the blueprints, and machines in the Sota Desert.
If they did not obtain the White Stone today, Zipple would have to return empty-handed, even after fighting with an unmanned being close to creation.
"Yes, I will prepare the Demon Stone and infiltrate."
To acquire the White Stone, which was already being opened, the Demon Stone was absolutely necessary.
"It will take some time for the Demon Stone to open, so until then, I will also fight with the Lord."
"No, I will use the Demon Stone myself. You wait in the castle and take measures so that the aftermath of the battle does not affect the White Stone."
"You are worried about the possibility of Runcandel allying with Hairan."
Now that Ron had awakened in a new realm, it wasn't impossible that Runcandel would side with Hairan from the start, as Octavia had said.
But Kelliark thought the possibility of Rosa making such a decision was low. As Runcandel, having Ron appear actually gave them more opportunity to observe.
"No, the Demon Stone is necessary even if it is assumed that it is only to deal with Ron Hairan. The current Ron is... except for Chiron, no one can defeat him."
Octavia widened her eyes in surprise.
She too had seen Ron's transcendental power with her own eyes, but she had not recognized its level as perfectly as Kelliark had.
Only those on a similar level can recognize it clearly. All of the magicians of Zipple, including Octavia, were far below Ron.
'I didn't know that not bringing Hedo and Kadun would lead to such a painful situation. I didn't want to reveal the power of the Demon Stone unless it was to face Runcandel.'
-I heard that you need the power of that fire dragon to use the perfect flame.
Jin's taunt from earlier came to mind. Now he couldn't deny those words.
'I've already lost face too much. I now understand how those who have been dealing with Jin Runcandel have felt.'
Octavia nodded.
"......Understood. Be careful, Lord."
"You be careful too, the infiltration won't be easy."
The Ghost Legion were gathering around Octavia. Those thirty grey robes were the real deal, on a different level than those resurrected ones.
Kelliark knew what the dragons mixed among the fleet were worrying about, without looking at their faces.
"Murakan has not regained his power from a thousand years ago. If he had, the first battle wouldn't have ended like that, so make sure the dragons are not caught by the ghosts and make a mistake."
As soon as Kelliark finished speaking, a new and deeper fear entered the dragons' eyes.
It wasn't because he was more fearsome than the old Murakan.
Hiiii...
A chilling sound of wind started somewhere within the fleet.
It sounded like the breath of some monster. The dragons of Zipple trembled and bristled their scales as soon as they heard the sound.
It was the sound that began with the opening of the Mashin stone.
The imitation that reproduced the 'Origin Stone' had the power to oppress the dragons with instinctive fear, just as Quikantel first experienced when fighting Andrei in the past.
The Mashin Stone is still incomplete, but it is much more sophisticated than then. The fear felt by the dragons was amplified accordingly.
"Quikantel!"
Even Quikantel, who was far away from the Mashin Stone, staggered as if to fall. Murakan supported her as she gasped for rough and unstable breath.
"Zipple bastards brought the Mashin stone... Damn, I can't gather strength in my body."
"Don't talk and just breathe deeply. Kiddo, this guy can't participate in the fight. She can't retreat alone in this state. Escort her out of the Mashin stone's area and come back."
Quikantel didn't insist on fighting together. She was frustrated but acknowledged that she would be nothing but a burden in her current state.
Among the currently active dragons, there were only a few who could resist the energy of the Mashin Stone on their own. Among them, only Murakan and Misha were completely immune.

[If Quikantel is in this state, most of the dragons over there should be frothing and falling... That, that shining thing. Is it a necklace? It seems to block the energy of the Mashin stone to some extent.]
Murakan transformed into his true form and carried Quikantel on his back, saying that all the dragons of Zipple had something shining around their necks.

[It's closer to a shackle than a necklace. It looks quite unstable... Ron, it seems you're afraid of them. Seeing that you took out the Mashin stone while even risking friendly damage. Fight well until I return, everyone.]
Ron felt the energy of the Mashin stone more deeply than the dragons. The Mashin stone radiated a similar energy to the chaos of the white stone he had been fighting in his unconscious state.
As Murakan flew towards the rear, most of the dragons of Zipple felt relieved, misunderstanding that he was afraid of the power of the Mashin stone and had left.
"Jin."
"Speak, Lord Ron."

"There will be those who infiltrate the fortress. Octavia will likely take on that role. I will cover the entire battlefield, but there will inevitably be gaps. You and Vamel's coalition, along with the Sword Saints, block them. Can I trust you?"
It was a statement no different from Ron entrusting his back to them.
"It will be an honor."
"When the fight is over."
Ron placed his hand on Jin's shoulder and added,
"Let's have a drink together with my lovely grandson."
His voice was incredibly gentle, just like when he spoke to Dante.

Jin felt as if he was experiencing the warm affection of a 'grandfather', an entity he had never encountered in his life. It felt like receiving an unexpected gift on the eve of a war where fate was at stake.
Swoosh...
Rashid drew his sword from its sheath.
"Kelliark! Let's get started."
Ron's calm and low voice vibrated the area once again. Simultaneously, the flames enveloping Zipple's fleet grew denser, and the Phoenix Belrot roared.
The war had begun again.
The first move belonged to the Sword Emperor.
Ron swung his sword towards the center of the fleet at a not-so-fast pace.
However, even a layman could easily decipher his trajectory, which contained the transcendent realm he had achieved.
His formless sword energy began to cover the fleet even before his movement ended.
The invisible sword energy wildly tore at the curtain of fire spread by Kelliark and Belrot.
That was not all.
The formless sword energies that brushed past the fire curtain soon turned into a typhoon, completely covering Zipple's fleet and the Sword Emperor's surroundings.
For allies, it was a protective barrier, for enemies, a horrifying sword wind that tore flesh and bone.
With a single strike, Ron had turned the entire battlefield into his domain. His statement about 'covering the entire battlefield' was not merely a figure of speech.
From the start, Belrot struggled with the formidable formless sword energies, while Kelliark swung his Hroti with his eyes wide open.
Octavia couldn't even begin to infiltrate, unable to penetrate Ron's domain.
Kelliark was continuously causing spatial explosions in that direction to forcibly open a path, but it was not an easy task to push through that unstable gap.
The real ghosts tried to secure space by spreading a red abyss, and Kelliark began to summon another legacy of Leol Zipple.
"Luyan!"
However, Ron was not the only one on the battlefield. There was a reason why Ron had left the five Sword Saints of Hairan till the end.
The Sword Saints could only exert their greatest power when Ron was present.
"The use of the Overlord Sword is permitted. Show the enemies the power of the Sword Saints of Hairan."
